hidden_charges.description: Additional charges may increase your total cost.
hidden_charges.explanation_template: Additional charges may increase your total cost.
hidden_charges.recommendation_template: Ask for a complete schedule of charges and refund conditions.

high_interest.description: The interest terms may expose you to increased borrowing costs.
high_interest.explanation_template: The interest terms may expose you to increased borrowing costs.
high_interest.recommendation_template: Confirm the APR, reset mechanism, caps and total repayment cost.

penalty_clause.description: A stated penalty may increase costs following specified events.
penalty_clause.explanation_template: A stated penalty may increase costs following specified events.
penalty_clause.recommendation_template: Confirm penalty amounts, triggers, grace periods and any waiver rights.

foreclosure.description: The clause provides for enforcement against property or collateral.
foreclosure.explanation_template: The clause provides for enforcement against property or collateral.
foreclosure.recommendation_template: Review default triggers, notice requirements and opportunities to cure.

automatic_renewal.description: The agreement may continue automatically unless you act.
automatic_renewal.explanation_template: The agreement may continue automatically unless you act.
automatic_renewal.recommendation_template: Confirm renewal dates, notice windows and cancellation methods.

coverage_exclusion.description: A coverage restriction may limit benefits for the stated circumstances.
rule_patterns: \b(?:excluded from coverage|not covered|coverage (?:excludes|does not cover)|will not cover|policy excludes)\b
coverage_exclusion.explanation_template: A coverage restriction may limit benefits for the stated circumstances.
coverage_exclusion.recommendation_template: Check the excluded circumstances against the cover you need.

waiting_period.description: Benefits may be unavailable until a specified waiting period expires.
waiting_period.explanation_template: Benefits may be unavailable until a specified waiting period expires.
waiting_period.recommendation_template: Confirm the duration, affected benefits and any exceptions.

unilateral_change.description: One party may be able to change material terms or exercise unilateral discretion.
unilateral_change.explanation_template: One party may be able to change material terms or exercise unilateral discretion.
unilateral_change.recommendation_template: Ask for advance notice, objective limits and a right to exit.

other_risk.description: The clause contains another material restriction or obligation.
other_risk.explanation_template: The clause contains another material restriction or obligation.
other_risk.recommendation_template: Have a qualified reviewer assess the obligation and negotiate limits.

no_risk.description: No configured material-risk evidence was detected; this is not a guarantee of safety.
no_risk.explanation_template: No configured material-risk evidence was detected; this is not a guarantee of safety.
no_risk.recommendation_template: Verify the original agreement and terms relevant to your circumstances.
